question: Use a sledgehammer to crack a nut
options: To solve a complex problem easily
To be very careful while working
To use excessive force for a simple task
To work as a professional blacksmith
solution: This idiom means over-reacting to a small problem. चींटी मारने के लिए तोप चलाना या ज़रूरत से ज़्यादा ताकत लगाना।

question: Up to the mark
options: To be very poor and in debt
Good enough; meeting expectations
To mark answers in an exam
To finish a task very poorly
solution: Up to the mark means satisfying the standards. मानक के अनुरूप या उम्मीद के मुताबिक होना।

question: Under the weather
options: To be very happy and excited
Not feeling well; slightly ill
To check the weather forecast frequently
To travel during a storm
solution: Under the weather is a common way to say you are sick. तबीयत ठीक न होना या थोड़ा बीमार महसूस करना।

question: Up in the air
options: To be very happy and excited
To travel in a hot air balloon
To throw something high in the sky
Not yet settled or decided
solution: Up in the air means uncertain. कोई मामला जो अभी अधर में लटका हो या अनिश्चित हो।

question: Under fire
options: To be very angry at someone
To sit near a campfire
To work as a professional firefighter
Being attacked or strongly criticized
solution: Under fire means being targeted by critics. आलोचना या हमले का शिकार होना।

question: Up against the wall
options: To finish building a new wall
To be very strong and powerful
To stand near a building for shade
In serious difficulty with no escape
solution: This idiom means being in a desperate situation. भारी मुसीबत में फँसा होना जहाँ से निकलना मुश्किल हो।

question: Ups and downs
options: To go up and down the stairs
To travel to the mountains and valleys
To be very confused about a decision
Good and bad experiences; success and failure
solution: Life is full of ups and downs. जीवन के उतार-चढ़ाव या अच्छे-बुरे दिन।

question: Up the creek
options: In a difficult situation with no easy solution
To go on a boat trip in a river
To be very successful in a task
To find a simple path in life
solution: Up the creek means being in trouble. मुसीबत में फँसा होना जहाँ कोई सहारा न दिखे।

question: Under the table
options: To hide under a piece of furniture
Done secretly, especially illegal payment
To clean the floor of a room
To have a formal dinner with guests
solution: Under the table refers to bribes or secret deals. मेज के नीचे से यानी गुप्त रूप से गैरकानूनी लेन-देन करना।

question: Uncharted waters
options: To be very good at swimming
A new and unfamiliar situation with unknown risks
To follow a map to a hidden treasure
To swim in a deep ocean
solution: Uncharted waters means a completely new situation. अनजानी राह या अज्ञात क्षेत्र में कदम रखना जहाँ खतरे का पता न हो।

question: Under wraps
options: To reveal a secret to everyone
To be very cold and need a blanket
To keep something secret or hidden
To wrap a gift for a friend
solution: Under wraps means confidential. किसी चीज़ को गुप्त रखना या छुपाकर रखना।

question: Under duress
options: To work in a very hot environment
To be very calm and relaxed
To wear very expensive clothes
Forced to do something by threats
solution: Under duress means being compelled to act against your will. किसी के दबाव में या ज़बरदस्ती की स्थिति में कुछ करना।

question: Under a cloud
options: To travel in an airplane
To be protected from the sun
In a state of suspicion or disfavour
To be very happy and cheerful
solution: Under a cloud means being suspected of doing something wrong. संदेह के घेरे में होना या बदनामी की स्थिति में होना।

question: Up for grabs
options: To grab something quickly from a shop
To win a prize in a competition
Available to anyone who wants it
To be very greedy and selfish
solution: Up for grabs means it's there for the taking. सबके लिए उपलब्ध होना।

question: Under the wire
options: To just barely complete something within a deadline
To finish a task long before the time
To work as an electrician
To be caught in a difficult situation
solution: Under the wire means finishing at the last possible moment. ऐन वक़्त पर या समय सीमा खत्म होने से ठीक पहले काम पूरा करना।

question: Under someone's thumb
options: To have a physical injury on the thumb
Completely under someone's control
To help someone with a difficult task
To be very small and insignificant
solution: Under someone's thumb means having no freedom of action. किसी के इशारों पर नाचना या पूरी तरह नियंत्रण में होना।

question: Under the gun
options: To work as a soldier in a war
To be very brave and courageous
Under great pressure to do something
To ignore the risks of a situation
solution: Under the gun means facing a tight deadline or pressure. भारी दबाव में होना या काम जल्दी करने के लिए मजबूर होना।

question: Under lock and key
options: To be trapped in a small room
To work as a professional locksmith
Kept securely locked or guarded
To lose the keys to your house
solution: Under lock and key means stored very safely. किसी चीज़ को ताले में बंद या सुरक्षित रखना।

question: Up the ante
options: To decrease the price of a product
To increase the level of something especially demands
To follow a simple set of rules
To be very kind to a stranger
solution: Up the ante means to increase the risks or stakes. दाँव बढ़ाना या अपनी शर्तें और कठिन कर देना।

question: Up to the minute
options: To watch a clock constantly
Completely current; having latest information
To finish a task exactly on time
To be very late for an appointment
solution: Up to the minute means the most recent. एकदम ताज़ा जानकारी या आधुनिकतम।

question: Under someone's nose
options: Very close to someone but not noticed
To be very proud of one's appearance
To have a physical problem with the nose
To follow someone's instructions blindly
solution: This idiom means something happened right in front of you. किसी के बिल्कुल सामने या नाक के नीचे कोई काम होना।

question: Under the sun
options: To enjoy a sunny day at the beach
To predict the weather correctly
To be very hot and exhausted
Anywhere in the world
solution: Under the sun means anything that exists on earth. इस दुनिया में कहीं भी।

question: Up in arms
options: To surrender in a battle
To be very happy and celebrate
Angry and ready to fight or argue
To exercise to build arm muscles
solution: Up in arms means protesting strongly. विरोध में उठ खड़ा होना या बहुत नाराज़ होना।
